name: Energy Ledger
description: The site's energy and money journal: one record a day from the energy field, the grid connection and the heatings - energy, money, the baselines; the savings bridge (without the system - heat pumps - heat storage - own energy - sales = paid) for a day, a month, a year; the month's calendar; who the energy was for - the cost accounts (private, business, what to re-bill to tenants). The batteries' plan and its strategies, the learning, the day's review, the operational days' notes (holidays, outages, maintenance), the similar days; the AI's daily report and day plan.

workTypes.title: Daily Report
workTypes.description: Yesterday in money and energy, what the plan did, anomalies (a PV block under its neighbours), what to change
workTypes.start: Report on yesterday for {name}: the money and the energy, what the plan did, anomalies, what to change.

workTypes.title: Day Plan
workTypes.description: Today's energy strategy: the day's notes, the similar days, the forecast and the prices - check the ledger's plan, adapt the strategy and the reserve, say in words what the site does today
workTypes.start: Plan today for {name}: the day's notes, the similar days, the forecast - which strategy and reserve, and why.
